name: M2 heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M2 x 3)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 3.2 mm hole at least 4 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M2 x 3 is 3 mm long and 3.6 mm across the knurl, wants a 3.2 mm hole at least 4 mm deep and at least 1.3 mm of plastic around the hole. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
